mechanism: Gentamicin's broad-spectrum bactericidal activity destroys beneficial intestinal flora including probiotic organisms, reducing probiotic efficacy and increasing risk of dysbiosis and antibiotic-associated diarrhea.
action: Administer probiotics at least 2-3 hours apart from gentamicin; consider delayed probiotic initiation until after gentamicin course completion or use gentamicin-resistant probiotic strains.
